description: This file contains utility functions for managing WAN traffic data, including DSCP node management, client list handling, and network interface status retrieval, primarily for the COSA Data Model Library.

classes.name: pstDSCPInfo_t
classes.description: Pointer to DSCP information node structure, representing a DSCP node with associated clients and tree links.

methods.name: SetMemoryslab
methods.description: Calculates memory slab size based on number of clients.

methods.name: NewNode
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new DSCP node.

methods.name: InsertDscpNode
methods.description: Inserts a DSCP node into the DSCP binary tree.

methods.name: ResetIsUpdatedFlag
methods.description: Resets the IsUpdated flags for all DSCP nodes and their clients.

methods.name: UpdateDscpCount
methods.description: Updates the DSCP tree with a list of enabled DSCPs and removes disabled nodes.

methods.name: DeleteDscpTree
methods.description: Recursively deletes the entire DSCP tree.

methods.name: DeleteDisabledDscp
methods.description: Deletes DSCP nodes that are marked as disabled (not updated).

methods.name: DeleteDisabledClients
methods.description: Removes clients marked as not updated from a DSCP node.

methods.name: InsertClient
methods.description: Inserts or updates client traffic data into the DSCP node's client list.
